subtitle: 약국 · 문장별 음성 재생
desc: 머리 아프거나 감기 걸렸을 때 약국에서

tips.en: Do you have anything for that?
Can I take this with food?
Take one tablet every six hours.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Excuse me. I have a headache. Do you have anything for that?
turns.ko: 죄송합니다. 머리가 아파요. 그거에 도움되는 거 있나요?

turns.speaker: Pharmacist
turns.en: Yes. This should help. Take one tablet every six hours.
turns.ko: 네. 이게 도움이 될 거예요. 여섯 시간마다 한 알 드세요.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Thank you. How much is it?

turns.speaker: Pharmacist
turns.en: It's eight dollars. Would you like a bottle of water as well?

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: No, thank you. Can I take this with food?
turns.ko: 아니요, 괜찮습니다. 음식이랑 함께 먹어도 되나요?

turns.speaker: Pharmacist
turns.en: Yes. It's better to take it after a meal.
turns.ko: 네. 식사 후에 드시는 게 좋습니다.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: I also have a runny nose. Do you have cold medicine?

turns.speaker: Pharmacist
turns.en: This one is for colds. It might make you sleepy.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: That's fine. I'll take both, please.

turns.speaker: Pharmacist
turns.en: Sure. Here's your change. Feel better soon.
